text:
Zara N: quick heads-up  support tickets keep asking if KMS keys move when you relocate a project. the region picker shows a tiny 'KMS' chip and people assume portability.
Ben C: yep, that's the confusion. we should avoid implying keys move. simplest fix: change chip tooltip to: 'Status: customer-managed key. Keys are region-bound; they will not transfer.'
Lina F: UX nit: that tooltip is long for mobile. shorter chip text + tappable 'Why?' that opens a small modal is safer.
Marcus H: copy for modal (short): 'Relocating may change retention and which keys are usable.' expanded bullets: 'Retention may default to the target region setting', 'Customer-managed keys are region-bound. You will need to add a new key in the target region or use platform-managed encryption', 'An audit entry will be created with tag "region-change".'
Zara N: accessibility: tooltip must be keyboard focusable and announced (aria-describedby). modal needs role=dialog, focus on title, and an aria-live polite banner after move.
Ben C: CTA options debate: primary 'Relocate project' vs 'Relocate and add key'. engineering prefers non-blocking moves; recommend primary 'Relocate project' and then show a persistent banner after move prompting key action.
Lina F: draft banner copy: 'Customer key not available in <region>. Add key' with secondary 'Remind me later'. Banner must use icon + text; don't rely on color alone and meet AA contrast.
Marcus H: audit log sample for UI: 'Zara N moved project delta from us-west1 to eu-central1; retention defaulted to 30 days; customer KMS unavailable.' machine-friendly: 'event=region_change actor=Zara_N from=us-west1 to=eu-central1 retention=defaulted_30d kms=unavailable tag=region-change'
Ops Bot: preview of chip + modal + banner pushed to staging at 1876543275
Zara N: final: ticket should include short + expanded modal copy, chip truncation rules for small screens, tooltip ARIA attributes, banner hex swatches + contrast checks, and the two-flow mock (modal-only vs modal + post-move banner). tagging @Lina F for a11y review and @Marcus H for audit log formatting. :white_check_mark:
